name: Camping 101: First Aid

angles.text: As a hunter, you can pair wilderness survival with First Aid to tend injuries far from civilization and town healers.
As a cook, you can learn the firecraft camp life needs for warmth, alongside the food that sustains you.

faq.answer: Byancie teaches in Dolanaar, a settlement on Teldrassil. She shows travelers skilled in medicine how to assemble First Aid Kits for wilderness camping.

aliases: what is first aid kit camp
how does first aid kit work
faq.answer: A camping First Aid Kit is a medical supply made by adventurers trained in First Aid. At an established camp, it gives them a place to tend wounds and provide healing in the field.
faq.q: What is a camping First Aid Kit?

faq.answer: Set up camp in the open wilderness, away from town borders. Residents and guards do not welcome temporary camps in settlement centers or city squares.
faq.q: Where can you set up a camp?

faq.answer: A campfire gives a wilderness camp heat, light, and safety. Cooks and culinary trainers can teach you to kindle one.
faq.q: Why is a campfire required for a camp?

faq.answer: Hunters often travel alone in remote wilds, far from healers and templars. First Aid lets them tend injuries while tracking game or surviving an ambush.
faq.q: Why is First Aid considered pragmatic for hunters?

aliases: how to get first aid kit
faq.answer: Show basic skill in First Aid, then ask Byancie in Dolanaar to teach you how to assemble a camping First Aid Kit.
faq.q: How do you learn to craft a camping First Aid Kit?

sections.body: Wild country brings bites from beasts and cuts from jagged ground. Rangers and other travelers may be far from town and its medical supplies. A First Aid Kit lets them tend minor wounds at a roadside camp before they grow grave beneath the open sky.
sections.title: Field Medicine in the Wilds

sections.body: In Dolanaar, Byancie teaches travelers skilled in triage to pack medical supplies for rough trails. Townsfolk do not allow tents and scattered supplies in the center of a settlement. Campers need to head into the forest before making camp.
sections.title: Lessons in Dolanaar

sections.body: An open flame begins a working camp. Set a campfire before laying out medical kits or bedding; it brings warmth and protection. Building and tending a fire is basic to surviving in the wild. Trainers recommend asking a cook to teach you to kindle one before tending a wilderness camp.
sections.title: The Hearth of the Camp

summary: In Dolanaar, travelers learn to prepare a First Aid Kit for camp. Byancie teaches how to tend wounds far from town healers and find a place to camp.
